title: Municipalities lookup table (profiles + project areas)
summary: Introduces municipalities table and municipality_id FKs on project_affected_barangays and profiles (custom_municipality_id). Web profile form and REST accept ids; barangay API prefers municipality_id query. Legacy custom_municipality name still supported on profile API read/write alias.

items: municipalities; project_affected_barangays.municipality_id; profiles.custom_municipality_id; backfill from prior municipality varchar
Location validation and joins by municipality id; list/search expose custom_municipality as joined name
POST custom_municipality_id; audit custom_municipality_id with human-readable municipality names; API payload + transformProfile
Area pairs use municipality_id from normalized project_affected_barangays join
Document municipalities resource and profile custom_municipality_id
